Priya Sharma 101  
Email: priya.sharma101@cybershieldtech.com | LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/priya-sharma101 | Location: Berlin, Germany  

A seasoned cybersecurity data scientist with six years of experience designing machine learning solutions to detect and mitigate cyber threats. Specializing in natural language processing, predictive modeling, and operationalizing data pipelines at scale. Proven ability to translate complex security challenges into actionable insights, reducing false positives by 32% and improving threat detection accuracy by 27% in production systems. Collaborated with cross-functional teams to integrate advanced analytics into enterprise security frameworks.  

At CyberShield Technologies, I led the development of end-to-end MLOps pipelines that streamlined the deployment of phishing detection models, achieving a 40% reduction in model retraining frequency. This work involved optimizing scikit-learn-based classifiers and integrating them with cloud infrastructure to support real-time analysis. I also spearheaded the adoption of time series analysis techniques to monitor network traffic patterns, enabling early identification of zero-day exploits. My contributions to the company’s NLP initiatives included refining transformer-based architectures to classify malicious URLs with 94% precision, which directly influenced the design of their threat intelligence dashboard.  

Previously, at Vulnerability Insights, I built predictive models that improved the accuracy of threat detection by 22% through the use of ensemble methods and hyperparameter tuning. This involved extensive SQL analytics on terabyte-scale log datasets, which were then processed using Pandas and NumPy for feature engineering. I also introduced A/B testing frameworks to evaluate the effectiveness of different model architectures, resulting in a 15% improvement in model performance.  

In my early career at SecureNet Solutions, I developed Python-based tools to automate the analysis of network traffic logs, identifying anomalies that signaled potential breaches. This role laid the foundation for my later work in cybersecurity, where I expanded my expertise in Tableau/Power BI to visualize security metrics and support decision-making at the executive level.  

**Technical Skills**  
- **NLP**: Architected transformer-based models for phishing detection, achieving 94% precision in classifying malicious URLs. Integrated BERT variants into threat intelligence systems, reducing false positives by 32%.  
- **scikit-learn**: Developed ensemble models that improved threat detection accuracy by 22% through hyperparameter tuning and feature selection.  
- **NumPy & Pandas**: Engineered features for predictive models using these libraries, processing datasets exceeding 10 terabytes in size.  
- **Time Series Analysis**: Designed pipelines to monitor network traffic patterns, enabling the early detection of zero-day exploits with 89% accuracy.  
- **SQL Analytics**: Extracted and analyzed log data from distributed systems, identifying anomalies that informed security protocols.  
- **Tableau/Power BI**: Created dashboards that visualized security metrics, supporting strategic decisions across three business units.  
- **MLOps (MLflow/W&B)**: Streamlined model deployment workflows, reducing retraining frequency by 40% and improving pipeline efficiency by 35%.  
- **A/B Testing**: Evaluated model architectures using controlled experiments, resulting in a 15% performance improvement in production systems.  
- **Python**: Developed custom scripts for log processing and model evaluation, reducing manual effort by 50% in threat analysis workflows.  

**Education**  
Master of Science in Data Science, Stanford University, 2020

English (native), French (fluent)
